name: Dead Is Dead
source:
On one fateful day, you run into an old friend and former lover. The two of you catch up and reminisce about the past, but things aren't what they seem, and you soon find that the whole world has been turned onto its head. Will you be able to face reality and let go of the past?

[From [url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/dead-is-dead]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个命运攸关的一天，你遇到了一位老朋友和前情人。两人追忆往事，但事情并非表面所见，很快你就发现整个世界都颠倒了。你能面对现实并放下过去吗？

[来自[url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/dead-is-dead]Itch.io[/url]]
